_comment: Zero-Trust Hybrid AI Pipeline - Claude Desktop MCP Configuration
_description: This configuration enables Claude Desktop to interact with your distributed AI infrastructure through MCP tools. Install location: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Windows)

mcpServers._comment_filesystem: Local filesystem access for project files
mcpServers._comment_orchestrator: Connect to the local orchestrator API for distributed inference
mcpServers._comment_aegis_shell: SSH shell access to Aegis (RTX 4080 Super inference node)

aegis-shell._note: Requires SSH key authentication configured for 'aegis' host

mcpServers._comment_ryzen_ai_shell: SSH shell access to Ryzen-AI (Multi-model node)

ryzen-ai-shell._note: Requires SSH key authentication configured for 'ryzen-ai' host

mcpServers._comment_postgres: Database access (if using PostgreSQL for logging)

postgres._note: Enable if using PostgreSQL for audit logging

mcpServers._comment_brave_search: Web search capability for research tasks

_setup_instructions.step2: Configure SSH keys for aegis and ryzen-ai hosts in ~/.ssh/config
_setup_instructions.step3: Copy this file to the appropriate location for your OS
_setup_instructions.step5: Verify MCP tools appear in Claude's tool list

_ssh_config_example.config:
Host aegis
    HostName aegis
    User your-username
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

Host ryzen-ai
    HostName ryzen-ai
    User your-username
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
